name: ReRemix - Tuggummi - PAK-9 - Beanies (Halloween Mix v1.01)

               /     _____/ /__      __/ |     |      /    /   /    _____/
             /     /___           /    /       |     |   /    /    /    /__

_________________________
                                                /       P A K - 9      A V S     5                                Beanies                  /______________________________
                 
Originally released as part of the Winamp Forums Compilation Pack 1, which was quite a good pack if I do say so myself. This version is unchanged apart from a small bugfix (beans dont fly off to infinity on pause now).

Not much to comment about it, I think it turned out well except the edges are a bit harsh because of the lack of anti-aliasing, you can add a blur on the end but then it just looks... well... blurred :/
__________________________
                                                   /    T U G G U M M I     R E M I X
              Halloween                  /_____________________________

Yes, those are *supposed* to look like carved pumpkins, but they didn't turn out so good because... i suck :P
Started doing this remix on 4th of September 2005 at around 12:00 and finished it 21:00. What can you do when you suddenly get a inspiration? Use it of course. Silly me. Anyway just so you know Pak, i didn't do this before you published your pack, because then it would've been in the pack instead of that... other preset. Well if you ever do Pack 5 SE... =/

  ***update for WFC 3***

Well i updated this preset a bit and i have to say i quite like it now, the pumpkins haven't changed at all so don't waste your time checking for that. What has changed is the fog for which i made a specific bitmap for, also i changed the ssc clouds to texer clouds (pak-9 you were right, it's much better now ;)), then i added the bats from my preset "return to castlevania", also added that iron fence to the background and finally i added stars to the sky so when you play very loud music the background won't be so empty :)
Well hope you enjoy this update too.
